status: Requirements and recommended behaviour for the deadline design; no application implementation authorised or performed
userQuestions: How do Studios set turnaround times?

Warn at the Brief stage and during the project when overruns threaten or pass final delivery.

verifiedCurrentCode.productionSettings: StudioProductionDefaults currently contains defaultTeam only; StudioProductionDefaultsPage edits that default team.
verifiedCurrentCode.brief: Brief includes Client deadline entry and a formatted date/countdown. No schedule-feasibility comparison was found in the inspected Brief implementation.
verifiedCurrentCode.ai: Ask Brisk responses are produced by getMockBriskAiResponse; no predictive deadline-risk monitor is implemented there.
verifiedCurrentCode.notifications: A Deadline changed notification copy/template exists. This does not establish an executing deadline-monitoring or Client-agreement workflow.
verifiedCurrentCode.existingDeadlineDisplay: Manual date countdown/overdue presentation exists in Videos, using the prototype's fixed reference date; it is not the proposed automatic per-stage turnaround system.

settingsProposal.location: Existing Studio settings / Production, with a Turnaround times section
configureOnce: Relevant stage or video-type exceptions, including animation and fixed dates
settingsProposal.inheritance: New projects inherit Studio rules. No repeated timing questionnaire at project creation. Producers only intervene for overrides or exceptions.
settingsProposal.startEvent: Only an applicable transition to Waiting on Studio creates the active stage turnaround deadline; Brief feasibility checks do not start future stage clocks.

recommendedChecks.rule: Compare the Client's requested final date with a provisional schedule using the known Brief scope, video duration, selected production flow, Studio rules and scheduled/fixed constraints.
recommendedChecks.studioUI: Show requested date, earliest/provisional estimate, missing inputs and assumptions. Producer can assess rush work or propose another date.
recommendedChecks.clientUI: Show Timing needs confirmation when the request conflicts with the estimate. A date request is not silently treated as an agreed promise.
recommendedChecks.caution: The estimate is provisional; Client review time, shoots and unknown scope must not be invented or represented as guaranteed.

recommendedChecks.rule: Reassess final-delivery risk on relevant stage changes, lateness, feedback handoffs, scope/duration changes and elapsed time. Client waiting time is outside the Studio turnaround clock but can still threaten the fixed final date.
recommendedChecks.studioUI: Warn the producer when the remaining schedule threatens the agreed final date, with the affected stage and cause.
recommendedChecks.clientUI: Recommend a Client-facing final-delivery risk update once the producer confirms forecast risk; do not expose every internal WIP overrun.
recommendedChecks.reviewStatus: Client risk-notification policy is a recommendation for Tom, not an approved automated messaging instruction.

recommendedChecks.rule: If final delivery remains outstanding after the agreed date, mark the missed date as Overdue for both Studio and Client. Retain the agreed date.
recommendedChecks.clientUI: Clear factual overdue status and any acknowledged revised date; do not quietly replace the original date.

dateChangeProposal.requestVersusCommitment: Treat the Client's Brief date as Requested delivery until the Studio confirms the commitment.
dateChangeProposal.ownership: Producer proposes an achievable revised date, with a short reason and Client agreement before changing the agreed final deadline.
dateChangeProposal.history: Keep original requested/agreed dates, proposed dates and confirmed changes distinct. Internal stage overrides remain separate from changing a Client commitment.
dateChangeProposal.ai: Use schedule calculations to detect known date conflicts. AI may explain causes, suggest recovery options or draft a Client update for approval. It does not independently change promised dates or send communications.

beforeImplementation: Approve the UI states and any new requested/agreed/proposed date states.
Decide whether forecast-risk Client notifications require producer confirmation; recommendation is yes, while factual overdue status is visible automatically.
Agree how Client consent to a revised final date is represented in the prototype.
Define forecast assumptions, including Client review allowance and incomplete Brief information.
Bound notification frequency to meaningful risk-state changes.
Keep this a front-end mock reference; no backend scheduler, AI integration or real notification sending authorised.

sharedDefaultsRefinement.rule: One shared Studio default with populated stage overrides; supersedes separate blank per-stage entry.
